about: Test questions for Ask (src/chat/chat.mjs). Each has what the search should and shouldn't do; scripts/ask-eval.mjs runs them all and scores the answers. Add the questions that matter to you, especially ones Ask got wrong. A question is {ask, expect}, or a chat of several: {turns: [{ask, expect}, ...]}. Checks: with (catalog ids the search must use), notWith (ids it must not use), without (ids it must leave out), notWithout (ids it must not leave out), course, cuisine, diet, maxTime (time filter at most this), site (a creator's id), new (true: only new this week), show (recipes or videos), sidesFor (the dish the sides are for, lowercase), noQ (no dish words), q (dish words must include this), noSearch (shows nothing, for questions that aren't recipe searches), noNames (the reply must not contain these words), minResults (the shown search must find at least this many; 1 unless set, 0 to skip). Every answer is also checked for naming a recipe from its results.
